item.title: Alibaba to ban Claude Code in workplace over alleged backdoor risks, source says
Commodore 64 Basic for PostgreSQL
item.description:
📝 All of that now runs inside PostgreSQL. PL/CBMBASIC is a procedural language extension that executes function bodies on Commodore 64 BASIC V2. CREATE EXTENSION plcbmbasic; CREATE FUNCTION hello(who text) RETURNS text AS $$ 10 PRINT "HELLO, ";WHO$;".
🔗 Read more: https://thombrown.blogspot.com/2026/07/load-plcbmbasic81-commodore-64-basic.html
